title: Eugenicist elites become the Nordics

tellings.quote: and that's that these elites become the Nordics

plain: The elites who backed eugenics, the movement to breed a 'better' human race, in America, Britain and Germany between about 1890 and 1939 went on to become the 'Nordics', the name UFO stories give to tall, fair, human-looking visitors. The writer and researcher Jason Jorjani puts this theory forward, naming the birth control campaigner Margaret Sanger among those involved and crediting a work called Closer Encounters. If true, it would mean some of the beings in UFO reports were linked to this human movement.
